name: Karen
source:
"I knew it all along. But I was afraid to admit it."

She is strong-willed and stubborn, with a sharp tongue that is second to none. However, she also has a fragile side—easily hurt, quick to tears, and prone to loneliness. Her pride often gets in the way of being honest with her feelings, but once she opens her heart to someone, she suddenly becomes very affectionate and dependent. Because she helps care for orphans at a church, she is actually quite skilled at cooking.
